texts.en:
Now that we have given a command to our £science_ship£ Science Ships it's time to set off. We will need to unpause the Galaxy Map simulation before anything can happen.

To unpause the game;

£dot_green£ Press the Space Bar or select the Unpause icon in the top bar

                    £pause_button£
